name: Contact Link Button
author: Nutribox.vn

sections.description:
This plugin adds customizable contact buttons for various platforms such as Phone, Zalo, Facebook, TikTok, WhatsApp, Messenger, and more, allowing users to easily reach out through their preferred communication channels.

Manually

  1. Upload the ‘Contact Link Button’ folder to the ‘/wp-content/plugins/’ directory
  2. Activate the Contact Link Button plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress
  3. Go to “after activation” below.

Help

For support, visit: https://plugin.nutribox.vn/
sections.installation:
1. Visit ‘Plugins > Add New’
  2. Search for ‘Contact Link Button’
  3. Activate Contact Link Button from your Plugins page.
